description: Tracks and analyses personal expenses. Records new expenses and answers questions about spending by date range and category, backed by the ExpenseTracker MCP server.
name: Expense Tracker Agent

skills.description: Record a new expense with a date, amount, category, optional subcategory and note.
examples: Add an expense of 1500 for movie on 2026-07-16 with note 'family outing'
Log 250 rupees spent on groceries today
skills.name: Add Expense

skills.description: List individual expense entries within an inclusive date range.
examples: What did I spend on last week?
skills.name: List Expenses

skills.description: Summarize spending totals grouped by category over a date range, optionally filtered to a single category.
examples: How much did I spend on travel this quarter?
skills.name: Summarize Expenses

skills.description: List every expense category present in the database.
skills.name: List Categories
